stemMd: Which statement cannot be true in any permitted order?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Review and Procedure must not occupy consecutive positions.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Review and Negotiation must not occupy consecutive positions.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Review and Procedure must occupy consecutive positions, in either order.

explanationMd:
Test whether each proposed statement can be added consistently to the rules. "Procedure must be in position 3." is incompatible with every permitted order. The alternative statements each have a complete valid example, given in their feedback. To check impossibility, enumerate placements for the most restricted item or block, then remove every case breaking a rule.

Complete permitted orders (each arrow advances one position):
- Advice → Evidence → Negotiation → Procedure → Review
- Advice → Procedure → Evidence → Negotiation → Review
- Evidence → Negotiation → Advice → Procedure → Review
